corrections.title: Xero's connection limit
corrections.detail: Early research pointed to a limit of 25 connections, but that came from forum posts about six years old. Xero's FAQ now describes tiers from 5 connections to no limit, so the guide was rebuilt around them.

corrections.title: Spotify's real blockers
corrections.detail: Reading the quota page showed the 5-user cap and the 250k monthly user threshold. Reading the Developer Policy found a ban on ingesting Spotify Content into AI models. That changed the guide's biggest risk, since it matters more to an agent than any setup step.

corrections.title: Short quotes proved nothing
corrections.detail: The first check marked claims verified when words like "403" or "minimum" appeared on a page. Quotes now need at least 4 words, and we replaced the weak ones with real sentences.

corrections.title: Pages came back in Hindi
corrections.detail: Google localized a docs page based on location, which would have made English quote checks depend on where the server runs. Every request now asks for English.

corrections.title: Summaries weren't word-for-word
corrections.detail: A summarizing tool supplied a Composio quote that didn't match the page once a link was involved, and a Gmail passage was reworded. We now strip markdown links before matching, and we removed the passage we couldn't confirm.

corrections.title: Unsupported detail removed
corrections.detail: A statement that repeat Shopify cooldowns get longer had no matched passage, so it came out of the guide.

corrections.title: Which demo apps to show
corrections.detail: The first plan favored well-known apps. Composio's directory showed Slack, LinkedIn and others are already managed, so we added Spotify, Shopify and Xero, where developers must bring their own app and the challenges differ.

unverified: We didn't create an OAuth app with any provider or request any approval, because this run had no provider accounts. Steps come from documentation, and hands-on times are our estimates.
Xero's certification requirements appeared only in search results. The pages have no readable text without JavaScript, so those claims are shown as inferred.
Xero's limit on uncertified apps per organization is unresolved. A search result said 5, and its FAQ gives an example of 2.
Gmail's scope classifications and Xero's pricing table are table cells, so an agent read them, but no sentence could be matched.
Which scopes Composio's managed Gmail app is approved for, and how long Google's security assessment takes or costs.
Review times for Shopify's App Store and Google's sensitive scopes. The pages we read don't state them, so those waits are shown as unknown.
